source_scope: BRAAS roof detail album, complete physical pages 1-55
critical_findings: All 55 physical pages are construction/detail sheets and are now routed by eleven junction families.

Legacy page titles contained several inferred/incorrect variants; v2.4 replaces them with visually verified headings, including one-slope ridge variants on pages 21-23 and minimum-slope/solid-deck range wording on pages 10-11, 19, 33-34 and 39.
Only printed numeric/symbolic values were retained. No distance was measured from the scanned drawings.
Cross-sheet references such as “по узлу 1/12/24/29/32/42” are explicit machine relations, so repeated macro geometry is not silently reinterpreted.
BRAAS product names are catalog nodes only; exact product geometry and manufacturer technical statements are not promoted to normative or structural rules.
